title: Feature to expand the Quicklauncher's popup on mouse hover
line: Quicklaunch has a new "Open popup on hover" option that opens its popup when you rest the pointer on the arrow.
explanation: Quicklaunch's popup with extra launchers could only be opened by clicking its arrow, which is slower on small screens. The change adds an "Open popup on hover" option (off by default, only enabled when the popup is on): resting the pointer on the arrow for a moment opens the popup, and it closes again shortly after the pointer leaves both the arrow and the popup. Clicking the arrow while it is hover-opened pins it open, as a normal click-opened popup.

commits.message:
applets/quicklaunch: add an option to open the popup on hover

The popup with the extra launchers could only be opened by clicking its
arrow. A new "Open popup on hover" option opens it when the pointer rests
on the arrow and closes it again once the pointer leaves arrow and popup.

BUG: 498275

media.caption: Master: resting the pointer on the Quicklaunch arrow only shows its tooltip
With the option on: hovering the arrow opens the popup, it stays open while the pointer is in it, and closes when the pointer leaves
New "Open popup on hover" option under "Enable popup"
